method: Each page rendered with Poppler pdftoppm 24.02.0 at 100 dpi in 8-bit grey; the body pixels, excluding a 60 pt band at the top and at the bottom of each page (running header and page number), compared by SHA-256. A page counts as unchanged only if its body pixels are identical at that resolution.
relocated_pages_note: New page number to baseline page number. No page moved.
edited_pages_note: Every changed page has an edited passage; no page changes by reflow alone.
visual_check: All 5 changed pages rendered at 70 dpi and inspected one by one; no clipping, overlap, missing text or displaced header or footer was found
tool: pixcmp.py in this record, which implements the method stated above.
